args.lesson: Worked: after several stalled turns of re-reading sources, one generator script rendered every displayed fact directly from the saved official records, so facts could not drift from the source, and reverse-removal of the two added paragraphs reproduced the live baseline hash. Failed: a single argv over 8192 chars was refused (fixed by splitting the script across argv items joined with exec), and one of my own checks expected 1 identifier occurrence where the unchanged mailto has 2; I corrected the check and kept the first-run failure on record. Next time: stop re-discovering once sources are saved and build in the same turn; derive check expectations from the baseline instead of guessing. Preparation only: no deployment, exposure, demand or revenue.
